records.note: Present-tense assertion that the Change Healthcare cyberattack does not matter financially to UnitedHealth Group. 'Matters financially' names no metric, threshold or series (revenue, earnings, guidance or share price), so no quantity event can be written without inventing a benchmark. No horizon words. A third party (UnitedHealth Group) would decide; the forecaster holds no disclosed role there.

Two rhetorical questions about a past motive for executive share sales at UnitedHealth Group. No future state is asserted: 'maybe there is another, worse reason' speculates about a hidden present fact with no observable event, deciding body or resolution source. VAGUE would also apply.

Relays information from named sources ('according to Optum insiders..., comments on TikTok, and The Layoff.com') about another organization's internal action (closure of the Optum Virtual Care team), which the author himself calls unconfirmed. Passes on information rather than an expectation.

'Something that will generate significant shareholder value' is a slogan with no observable event, benchmark or threshold; 'wait and see' is not a deadline. The context marks the sentence as sarcastic, so SATIRE would also apply; VAGUE holds under a literal reading and does not depend on tone.

Announcement of the author's own live event (Rapid Acting Mental Health Treatment NYC, 5 May 2024); the author is the organizer of RAMHT per the affiliations list. Own-organization event, not a third-party decision. Also outside the five areas.
Announcement of the author's own conference appearance (ATA Nexus, Phoenix, 7 May 2024). The forecaster's own action, not a third-party decision. Also outside the five areas.

Announcement of the author's own role as co-chair of the Summit on Breakthrough Therapies for Addiction (15-16 May 2024). The forecaster's own action and event, not a third-party decision. Also outside the five areas.

Listing of a virtual conference (5-7 June 2024) under the author's own appearances ('Other Times to Catch Me Live'), with an affiliate link. Schedule information about the author's own activity, not an expectation about a third-party outcome. Also outside the five areas.

The author's reading of UnitedHealth's statement to Endpoints News: Optum's virtual care business closes as it stands. It passes on and interprets reported information about another organization's internal action (a closure) rather than stating an expectation. The post itself treats the shutdown as confirmed ('I was right'), so KNOWN would also apply.

'They can always acquire more' states a capability with the quantifier 'more' and no countable set: no target, number, period or resolution source can be written. A quip, not a forecast with an observable event.

'Well on its way to becoming a medicine' names no regulator, indication, product or threshold, and 'becoming a medicine' has no single resolution source. No lexicon phrase and no horizon words. An approval event would require inventing the regulator and the indication.

Methodological expectation that future ibogaine trials will be extremely hard or impossible to blind. No trial, benchmark (for example a blinding index) or resolution source can be written from the words; blinding success is not a trial outcome under the trial_result template. OUT_OF_AREA would also apply.
'We may need to look at design that look at within subjects controls' is a design recommendation ('need to') with no predictive reading of a third-party outcome.

Repeat announcement of the author's own conference appearance (ATA Nexus, Phoenix, 7 May 2024) in a different post. The forecaster's own action. Not DUPLICATE: the earlier capture (owen-0998) is from another post.

Repeat announcement of the author's own co-chair role at the 15-16 May 2024 Miami Beach summit, in a different post. The forecaster's own action and event. Not DUPLICATE: the earlier capture (owen-0999) is from another post.

Repeat listing of the 5-7 June 2024 virtual Neurodiversity conference under the author's own appearances, with an affiliate link, in a different post. The author's own activity; also outside the five areas. Not DUPLICATE: the earlier capture (owen-1000) is from another post.

Line spoken by a fictional character (the author's alter ego) in a fictional TV pilot with an ironic disclaimer; not the forecaster's own sincere words. Even read as sincere, 'the future is AI' and 'I don't have to [write] any more notes' give no countable set, metric, threshold or deciding body, so VAGUE would also apply.
Promise of the next installment of the author's own newsletter serial; the forecaster's own publication. Also outside the five areas.
Doubt about the staying power of written media against short video. Not a regulatory, trial, company or market, payer or policy, or practice adoption outcome. Also no benchmark or resolution source.
Societal claim about declining teen sexual activity and 'the future of humanity'. Not one of the five areas. Also no observable event or benchmark.

Conditional claim about stigma dynamics: if many clinicians disclose, punishing an individual 'becomes less plausible'. Not one of the five areas; 'less plausible' has no benchmark or resolution source.
Invitation to the author's own RAMHT live event (Sunday 5 May 2024, NYC); the author is the organizer per the affiliations list. Own-organization event, not a third-party decision.

Incomplete sentence that trails off. 'Everyone who will sue them' is a quantifier with no countable set (which plaintiffs, how many suits, which court) and no deadline; the main clause is a hypothetical about UnitedHealth's legal resources, not an observable outcome. Class actions over the Change Healthcare breach had been reported before the statement date, so a bare 'lawsuits are filed' reading would also fail the KNOWN test.
Reminder of the author's own RAMHT 2024 NYC live event on Sunday 5 May 2024. Own-organization event, not a third-party decision.

'I really look forward to the results in subsequent phase 3 trials' states anticipation, a preference. The existence of phase 3 trials of COMP360 in PTSD is presupposed, not asserted with any lexicon phrase, and no direction is given for their result, so no trial_result proposition can be written; a phase 3 start is not one of the eight template outcomes. The forecaster holds no disclosed role in Compass Pathways.
'I hope this may be rediscovering a road back to healing' is a hope expressed in a metaphor; no entity, observable event, benchmark or threshold can be written.

'Nobel prize in waiting' implies a future Nobel prize for the Stanford accelerated TMS work. A prize award is not a regulatory, trial, company or market, payer or policy, or practice adoption outcome. Also hyperbolic praise with no date.
Statement of intent about the author's own writing: to dismantle the phrase 'the mental health crisis' in his newsletter. The forecaster's own action; also metaphorical and outside the five areas.
Statement of intent about the author's own usage in the newsletter ('I will dispense with it'). The forecaster's own action; outside the five areas.
Editorial plan for the author's own newsletter. The forecaster's own publication, not a third-party outcome.

Reports the Federal Trade Commission's vote to ban new noncompete agreements and the announced start 'in late August'. The deciding body had voted and announced the rule and its effective date before the statement date, so the statement passes on a public decision rather than an expectation. A reading 'the ban actually takes effect' would need a benchmark (for example the outcome of court challenges) that the author did not give.
Announcement of the author's own co-chair role at the Summit on Breakthrough Therapies for Addiction (15-16 May 2024) and of the topics the meeting will cover. The forecaster's own event and action.

Descriptive account of the PTSD treatment pipeline at the statement date: MDMA under FDA review with Lykos, psilocybin analogs, magnesium-ibogaine. 'Hopeful' describes publications and 'coming out' is not a deadline; no approval or trial outcome is asserted. A restatement of a pending review, not an expectation.

General mechanistic expectation that treatments acting on the nucleus accumbens 'will have a hard time' changing what it does. No entity, trial, benchmark or resolution source can be written; a truism rather than an observable event.

'GLP-1s might be helpful for addictions' is a class-wide efficacy possibility with no named trial, endpoint, indication or threshold; 'helpful' has no benchmark and no single resolution source. Writing a trial_result event on SEMALCO (mentioned only in the context as recruiting) would invent the trial and the endpoint the author did not name. 'Might' would set bin C had an event been writable.

The author's own attendance plan at thinc360 (the following week) because his own organization, Acacia Clinics, is a finalist for an award. Own action and own-organization item; also outside the five areas.

Vision statement ('I see a future that has less suffering, more effective treatments...'). Comparatives ('less', 'more', 'faster', 'safer') with no benchmark, series or period; the next sentences frame it as an aim.
'Technology can get us there when compassion and sense are augmented' states a capability toward an undefined goal; no entity, observable event or benchmark can be written.

'We're going to have lawsuits for mental health parity violations' uses the plural quantifier 'lawsuits' with no countable set: no plaintiff class, defendant, court, number or period is given, and a lawsuit filing is not one of the eight template outcomes. Parity (MHPAEA) lawsuits already existed at the statement date, so a bare 'at least one lawsuit is filed' reading would also fail the KNOWN test. 'Going to' would set bin A had an event been writable.

'I don't see any way towards parity of better treatments' names no benchmark, metric or resolution source for 'parity of better treatments'; the supporting clause (treater shortage) is present-tense analysis. 'I don't see any way' would map to bin D or E had an event been writable.
